# Chrome Stream MCP

> Low-bandwidth native Rust Chrome DevTools Protocol (CDP) screencast relay, interactive browser controller, and SEP-1865 MCP App server for viewing and controlling local Google Chrome tabs over slow or remote connections.

## For AI Agents

- [Agent Skill](skills/chrome-stream/SKILL.md): Complete MCP tool reference (`chrome_stream_stage`, `chrome_stream_connect`, `chrome_stream_disconnect`), Chrome debugging setup, and weak-network workflows (`agentskills.io` compatible).
- [Contributor & Agent Guide](AGENTS.md): Architecture, Cargo/panel test commands, loopback security boundaries, and plugin packaging rules.
- [README (English)](README.md) | [README (简体中文)](README.zh-CN.md)

## Quick Connect (Any MCP Client)

Install the prebuilt binary (macOS / Linux):
```sh
curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/eatingDream-antigravity-plugins/chrome-stream-mcp/main/scripts/install.sh | sh
```

Generic stdio MCP configuration (`mcpServers`):
```json
{
  "mcpServers": {
    "chrome-stream-mcp": {
      "command": "~/.gemini/config/plugins/chrome-stream-mcp/bin/chrome-stream-mcp",
      "args": [
        "serve",
        "--data-dir", "~/.gemini/antigravity/plugin_data/chrome-stream-mcp",
        "--panel-html", "~/.gemini/config/plugins/chrome-stream-mcp/panel/dist/panel.html"
      ]
    }
  }
}
```

## Public MCP Tools

- `chrome_stream_stage`: Opens the live viewer (`ui://chrome-stream-mcp/stage`) and reports relay/Chrome readiness without auto-connecting.
- `chrome_stream_connect`: Connects to the persistent `0600` local relay and streams the active tab (`qualityPreset?: "auto" | "ultra" | "low" | "medium" | "high"`, `rttMs?`).
- `chrome_stream_disconnect`: Stops screencasting and closes the Chrome CDP WebSocket.

## CLI Subcommands

- `chrome-stream-mcp serve [--data-dir <path>] [--panel-html <path>]`
- `chrome-stream-mcp relay [--data-dir <path>]`
- `chrome-stream-mcp doctor [--json]`
